scope: Descriptive analysis after frozen model selection, fresh confirmation and independent audit; no reselection or tuning.

reproduction.description: Every child, mutation event, random immigrant, parent selection, retained population and RNG hash replayed from the verified starting state; no candidate inference.
reproduction.parent_counterfactual: Same current population and identical RNG state immediately before each actual parent draw, alternate global/case priority; descriptive, not a second evolved trajectory.

validation_archive_changes.scope: Post-hoc descriptive analysis of logged validation selection; no new inference or tuning

syntactic_dependencies.caveat: Conservative syntactic dependencies only; quiescence and semantic redundancy are not captured.

interventions.scope: Post-hoc success-conditioned interventions on reused final inputs; no new generalization estimate
interventions.interpretation: No-goal-pulse still retains the static goal flag. Nonlocal ablation replaces radius>1 read values with zero, retaining read charges; it does not substitute local reads.
